integrity: Exact arithmetic checker independently reconstructs and verifies the rational identities, Hurwitz criterion, root enclosure and six Bernstein positivity certificates. The argument derives an infinite circle/disk assertion from these exact polynomial inequalities, not from finite sampling. Unindexed literature remains a novelty risk.
scientific_limitations: Fixed normalized ellipse only; sharp local-univalence disk, not global injectivity; no characterization of exterior critical set or other parameters.
title: Sharp disk-wide local-univalence radius for the Dorff ellipse self-convolution
